title: The Bread Crust Map
youtube_title: The Bread Crust Map | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Chioma finds a bread crust with a pattern like a coastline. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Chioma shows Delia how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
